name: SHARK_ST_IDLE
meaning: SetState 1: anim idleAnim; Update: switches idleAnim to 6 after idleTimer (inferred)

name: SHARK_ST_AIM
meaning: SetState 3: anim STAND1, aimTimer 2000; Update: -> 7 when the timer ends (inferred)

name: SHARK_ST_LOOK
meaning: SetState 6: level rotation, anim LOOK; Update: -> 1 (inferred)

name: SHARK_ST_LUNGE
meaning: SetState 8: anim SWIM1 toward the Wolf; Update: -> 9 in reach (inferred)

name: SHARK_ST_BITE
meaning: SetState 9: anim EAT, MSG_KILL arg 5 to the Wolf (inferred)

name: SHARK_ST_SWIM_BACK
meaning: SetState 0xc: anim SWIM1 back to lungeFrom; Update: -> 6 (inferred)
